title: IPRA – lapel video & 911 – Luis Sanchez – Tijeras NM, Feb 17, 2026

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the New Mexico Inspection of Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Copies of the following records related to the shooting at the Leisure Mountain Mobile Home & RV Park, 700 block of NM-333, Tijeras, NM, on February 17, 2026 (about 1:18 a.m.), for which Luis Sanchez (41) was arrested:

1. All on-body (lapel) camera recordings of all deputies who responded, including the approach, use of the taser, the arrest and transport of Luis Sanchez.
2. All dash-camera recordings, if any.
3. Recordings of all interviews of Luis Sanchez.
4. Recordings of all 911 calls and dispatch radio traffic for this incident, and the CAD event report.
5. The incident report(s), supplemental reports, and the criminal complaint / statement of probable cause.
6. Booking photograph of Luis Sanchez.

I understand that images and identifying information of the minor victims will be redacted. I prefer electronic delivery (download link). If any portion is withheld, please cite the specific exemption and release all reasonably segregable portions. If fees exceed $25, please contact me before processing.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 15 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Vitaliy Cherniak

title: Bodycam & interview – Arnold Barney – Mesa AZ, July 28, 2025

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Arizona Public Records Law, I hereby request the following records:

Copies of the following records related to the death of the 6-week-old son of Arnold Barney (19), at an apartment complex near Alma School Rd & Southern Ave, Mesa, AZ, on July 28, 2025 (about 8:30 p.m.), for which Arnold Barney was arrested and later indicted by MCAO (on or about August 12, 2025):

1. Body-worn camera recordings of all responding officers at the scene.
2. Recordings of the detective interview(s) of Arnold Barney.
3. 911 call recording(s), dispatch radio traffic and the CAD event report.
4. The departmental report (DR) and the probable cause statement / affidavit.

Statement of commercial purpose (A.R.S. § 39-121.03): the records will be used in a documentary video analyzing the police response and investigation, published on a monetized YouTube channel. The records will not be used for solicitation or for compiling mailing lists. Images of the child victim may be redacted.

Please provide a fee estimate before processing. Electronic delivery is preferred. If any portion is withheld, please cite the specific basis and release all reasonably segregable portions.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 10 business days.

Sincerely,

Vitaliy Cherniak

title: Body Worn Camera – Oct 16, 2025 homicide – Joelene Rodriguez

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Washington Public Records Act, I hereby request the following records:

Per RCW 42.56.240(14)(d), the incident is identified as:
- Person(s) involved: Joelene Rodriguez (also known as Joelene Evans), age 45; victim Jaxson J. Rantala, age 4
- Date, time and location: October 16, 2025, approx. 4:00-5:00 p.m., Cedar Crossing apartments, Roosevelt Way NE (6200-6600 block), Seattle
- Incident: homicide investigation reported on the SPD Blotter on October 16, 2025 ("Detectives investigating homicide in North Seattle"); King County charges of first-degree murder filed on or about October 21-22, 2025

Records requested:
1. All body worn camera recordings of responding officers, including the contact with and arrest of Joelene Rodriguez.
2. Recordings of interviews of Joelene Rodriguez.
3. 911 call recordings, dispatch/radio audio and the CAD report.
4. The General Offense report and supplemental narratives.

Please provide records in installments as they become available. If redaction costs under RCW 42.56.240(14)(f) apply, please send an estimate before proceeding. If any record is withheld, please identify the exemption and the record withheld.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 5 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Vitaliy Cherniak
